QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Invitation to Ereve
QuestInfo.0: Agent N wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1:
Empress Cygnus of Ereve wants to see you. Could she be related to Empress Aria, who helped you and the other four heroes in the war against the Black Mage?

You should go check it out.
QuestInfo.2:
Cygnus is gathering Maple World's powers to keep the Black Mage in check.

She knows who you are and wants you to help. Perhaps it wouldn't be a bad thing to have allies ready to fight by your side...
